description:
A stranger tells me I'm his girlfriend!  
***  
Jake was rescued by the dream demon Bei before he died, and the two agreed to be together in the next life. However, the death of the dream demon dealt a huge blow to him. Just when he was at a loss, he actually met girl who looked like Bell in this world. Is this a coincidence, or is it destined?
